author: tracker_corpus_a
purpose: Compact follow-up for the existing tracker milestone on the same research page; not a new quality experiment and not a replacement for the earlier frozen milestone.

independent_owner_review.disposition: Independent semantic review now completes the earlier pending review requirement. The old adjudication remains unchanged with its historical pending flag; this receipt does not backdate or rewrite that state. Actual caption adoption and ownership still remain unresolved.

formal_training.progress_evidence: Only completed optimizer_step events are counted. A live process alone is not evidence of completed gradient work. No estimate of the unlogged partial group or remaining runtime is made.

throughput_observation.interpretation: Later emitted optimizer intervals are substantially longer than the early median, but additional optimizer updates completed. This establishes observed throughput decline with progress; it does not locate a slow phase or prove a hang. Loss values are training telemetry, not tracking-quality scores.

hypotheses_only: Whole-forward activation offload and pinned-memory transfers may add overhead.
Allocator caching, variable sequence shapes and Windows shared-memory residency may contribute.
CPU/GPU synchronization may expose transfer or driver latency.
not_established: No phase-level profile identifies forward, backward, optimizer or transfer as the measured bottleneck.
No proof of a memory leak, natural OOM, paging direction, or a measured frozen-head copy is available.
No controlled throughput comparison establishes an optimization benefit.
diagnostic_disposition.current_run_policy: This collection performs no restart, interruption, allocator mutation, code injection, training-data change, or training-code change.

sanitizations.action: replaced numeric process identifier with generic training-process reference

optimizer-steps.jsonl.transform: Parsed complete JSON lines, selected event=optimizer_step, checked strict numeric/log-field allowlist, serialized only those events. Non-event text and any incomplete JSON fragment are excluded.

source_result_reference.reason: Summary includes relevant status/configuration only; original result contains unnecessary local runtime identifiers.

public_download_checks.limits: Finite filename/content checks are not proof against arbitrary secret formats. Logical model-agent identifiers such as /root/tracker_corpus_a in the original review are task identities, not machine filesystem paths.

limits: This is a frozen point-in-time supplement; the source log may append later and later training status can differ.
The two reviewed examples are translated siblings from one exposed development family, not new training rows or held-out quality results.
Diagnostic hypotheses are unconfirmed and must not be presented as measured causes or successful optimizations.
The code review retains its original earlier evidence times; the optimizer-event snapshot independently shows progress after those observations.
The resource diagnostic references its original raw resource-samples JSONL, which is not included in this compact supplement; its interpretation is bounded by the recorded observations.
No final adapter evaluation, omission reduction, conversation rollout, long-history recovery or downstream user benefit is established.
No new model inference, test call, training run or source mutation was performed to prepare this supplement.
